eyebrow: Behind the scenes: sums of squares
code:
groups = (a, b, c)
grand = np.concatenate(groups).mean()
ssb = sum(len(g) * (g.mean()-grand)**2
          for g in groups)
ssw = sum(((g - g.mean()) ** 2).sum()
          for g in groups)
print(round(ssb / (ssb + ssw), 3))
# 0.077
caption: ssb = 1764.4, ssw = 21217.6: eta squared is 7.7%.
